fact_text: The KSE-100 touched 80,000 points on 21 Jun 2024, after which profit-taking and heavy selling pressure set in.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Banks carry a large weight in the KSE-100 because of their market capitalisation, so the index rise after the budget was driven mainly by bank share prices.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Pakistani banks other than Meezan have long traded at low P/E multiples and at price-to-book below 1x for about 15 years, while Meezan has traded at a premium above 1x.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Banks made up about 32 percent of market capitalisation around 2007-08, when they drove the KSE-100.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Most of the 80,000 rally was in blue-chip and speculative scrips, so many investors did not share in the index gain and growing companies were not re-rated.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Cement, steel and auto plants were running at roughly 30 to 50 percent capacity utilisation, which the analyst says blocks fair price discovery until genuine sales and production numbers grow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer's new plant, about 1 million tonnes a year, had been shut for maintenance and press reports say it has restarted.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: With the older Daharki plant of similar size, Engro Fertilizer's urea capacity is about 2 million tonnes a year, so urea supply stays intact if both run.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: The analyst calls Engro Fertilizer a dividend stock that has repeatedly beaten market expectations on its dividend payouts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Local mobile phone assembly output rose over the five months to June 2024, and the analyst sees this as good for local supply.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: The analyst rates the mobile assembly performance of Airlink and Lucky Mobile as very good among listed mobile assemblers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)

fact_text: Mobile phone exports, which took place around 2020-21, have not resumed because import problems since 2022 limited trade, so local supply and sales drive the segment.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Why did KSE 100 Index hit 80,000? | PSX Market Analysis & Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-21)
